about: Related use cases: links from public use-case records to Atlas capabilities, saying why a task needs a row. Need evidence only: no record names a subject, a support level or a confidence, and none changes a cell. Imported from a pinned commit of the contributing repository; refresh with refresh_use_cases.py. Review status is the Atlas's own and starts as unreviewed.
